description: The doc comment implicitly defines three classes: (1) Handled now: UTF8String, PrintableString, IA5String, VisibleString. (2) Deferred with clear v0.2 strategy: BMPString, UniversalString. (3) Permanent byte-exact fallback: TeletexString. This taxonomy is valuable API documentation because it lets users infer: 'BMPString matching will change in v0.2; TeletexString will not.' Worth keeping and making explicit in v0.1 rustdoc.
